title: DiscordSynkLeaderBoard
description: DiscordSyncLeaderboard is an advanced Minecraft plugin that provides a complete leaderboard system with global stats, Discord synchronization, animated holograms, and web dashboard control.
body:
![.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68c03cb25e4d50901c9669ed0f6c997209a4aefd.png)

🏆 DiscordSyncLeaderboard

🚀 The Ultimate Advanced Leaderboard Plugin for Minecraft
Global stats • Animated holograms • Discord sync • Web dashboard

✨ What is DiscordSyncLeaderboard?

DiscordSyncLeaderboard is a powerful and modern Minecraft plugin that allows you to track player statistics, create stunning hologram leaderboards, sync data with Discord, and manage everything from a web dashboard.

---

🌍 Global Network System

  • ✔ Works with BungeeCord / Velocity
  • ✔ One central MySQL database
  • ✔ Cross-server stat syncing
  • ✔ Supports multiple game modes
---

📊 Advanced Player Statistics

⚔ Kills
💀 Deaths
🏆 Wins
⏱ Playtime
📈 K/D Ratio
🎮 Games Played
🔥 Event Wins
💰 Coins (Vault support)
---

🔮 Animated Hologram Leaderboards

  • ✔ FancyHolograms support
  • ✔ Scrolling leaderboards
  • ✔ Rotating stats (kills, wins, playtime)
  • ✔ Animated titles
---

💬 Discord Integration

  • ✔ Auto leaderboard sync to Discord
  • ✔ Embed messages
  • ✔ Configurable update intervals
  • ✔ Support request system
---

🤖 Discord Bot Features

/leaderboard
/stats
/support
/announce
---

🌐 Web Dashboard

  • ✔ Login with Discord
  • ✔ Auto detect servers
  • ✔ Manage leaderboards
  • ✔ View player stats
  • ✔ Control settings remotely
---

🎮 Commands

/leaderboard
/leaderboard kills
/leaderboard wins
/leaderboard playtime
/leaderboard global kills
/leaderboard season
/updates
/support
---

🧩 Placeholders

%ds_kills%
%ds_deaths%
%ds_wins%
%ds_playtime%
%ds_kd%

%ds_top_kills_1%
%ds_top_kills_2%
%ds_top_kills_3%
---

🔐 LuckPerms Support

Display player prefix and suffix directly in leaderboards.

---

⚡ Performance

  • ✔ Async database system
  • ✔ Cached leaderboards
  • ✔ Optimized for large servers
  • ✔ No TPS lag
---

🎁 Extra Features

  • ✔ Seasonal leaderboards
  • ✔ Top player rewards
  • ✔ Milestone announcements
---

⚙ Requirements

  • ✔ Paper / Spigot 1.20+
  • ✔ Java 17+
  • ✔ MySQL recommended
---

💬 Support

Need help? Join our Discord server:
